svg.title: Four patterns, as the parallel coordinates and the scatterplot show them
svg.desc: Two dimensions, A and B, drawn both ways. Rising together: level lines, climbing dots. A trade-off: crossing lines, falling dots. No relationship: tangled lines, a shapeless cloud. Outliers: lines that leave the bundle, dots away from the rest.
svg.text: More of A comes with more of B
More of A comes with less of B
A few options sit apart from the rest
